A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Good to know.

The details matter.
Here’s how it works.

What does our restaurant pay?+

There is no upfront cost or contract commitment. We provide the photographers and equipment, and your restaurant receives 20% of photo sales. We’ll discuss your venue’s specific arrangement before getting started.

Are guests expected to buy a photo?+

No. Photography and purchases are optional. Every photographed guest receives a complimentary personalized postcard, even if they don’t buy a framed photo. When someone declines, our photographer politely moves on.

What do the photos cost?+

A standard 4×6 photo in a restaurant-branded frame is $20, or $15 each when purchasing two or more. The same purchased photo is emailed at no additional charge. Glass frames are available at a higher price; ask our team for current pricing.

What space and staffing do we need?+

Your venue provides space for a small printing station—around three feet, or one meter, as an initial guide. We confirm the full footprint, placement, and installation needs together. Prime Capture brings the photographer and equipment, with no required venue staff involvement.

How do reporting and payments work?+

You receive daily sales reports and a Drive link to photo content. Your venue’s revenue share is paid every two weeks. We confirm payout contacts and accounting details when planning your partnership.

Where do you operate?+

We currently operate in Miami. Service days and hours are arranged around each venue, whether that’s every day or your peak periods. Tell us about your location so we can discuss fit and availability.

YOUR PRIVACY

Your visit. Your choice.

Optional website analytics

If you allow it, Google Analytics measures visits, selected campaign links, and partnership inquiry actions: opening the form, starting it, attempting to send, and success or error outcomes. Photo help requests aren’t counted as partnership leads. We don’t send your name, email address, venue name, visit date, or message text to analytics. Advertising features are disabled.

Analytics loads only after you allow it. You can turn it off here at any time. We save your choice in this browser for up to six months and respect browser Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control signals.

How Google uses information from partner sites

Partnership inquiries

We use the contact and venue details you submit to respond to your inquiry. Resend delivers the message to our business inbox. Our website is hosted by Vercel.

Photo help requests

We use your email address, venue name, visit date, and message to look into your photo request and reply to you. Resend delivers these details to our business inbox. Photo help submissions aren’t sent to Google Analytics.
